item.description: WebDAV error responses are not returning the correct Content-Type header. The test expects "application/xml; charset=utf-8" but gets "text/html; charset=utf-8" for error responses from WebDAV methods like PROPFIND, PUT, MKCOL, DELETE, MOVE, etc.
item.contract: When a WebDAV method (PROPFIND, PUT, MKCOL, DELETE, MOVE, PROPPATCH, LOCK, UNLOCK) encounters an error, the response should return XML error content with the correct Content-Type header "application/xml; charset=utf-8". For 401 errors, it should also include a WWW-Authenticate header.

item.description: Thumbnail error handling for 403 access denied returns "e404" instead of "e403" when unauthorized access is attempted to protected resources.
item.contract: When a thumbnail request is made for a resource that the user lacks access to (403 error), the SVG error response should display "e403" instead of "e404". This ensures consistent error messaging for unauthorized access attempts.

item.description: Copy operations with deduplication fail due to missing error handling in the copy functionality.
item.contract: When performing copy operations with deduplication enabled, the system should properly handle file system operations and validation to prevent failures during copy operations.
